title: Move Storybook-specific files (generate-stories.mjs, *.stories.tsx) out of packages/ui into apps/architecture-studio, so packages/ui never references Storybook at all
objective: Owner-directed architectural correction: 'eu quero que o pacote nem sabia que o storybook exista, ele precisa se autodocumentar de forma generica e agnostica' (I want the package to not even know Storybook exists; it needs to self-document generically and agnostically). packages/ui/scripts/generate-stories.mjs and packages/ui/stories/*.stories.tsx both import @storybook/react-vite types -- real Storybook awareness living inside a package meant to be tool-agnostic (DEC-049/ADR-0011). packages/ui/documentation/mesh/ui-doc-mesh.meta.v1.json and packages/ui/scripts/export-doc-mesh.mjs stay in packages/ui unchanged -- they are already generic (plain JSON, JSX-as-string snippets, no Storybook import) and are the correct place for the package's own self-description. Only the Storybook-consuming half moves to apps/architecture-studio (where Storybook itself is configured), reading that same generic JSON from the outside.
validations: DONE: packages/ui/scripts/generate-stories.mjs and packages/ui/stories/ deleted; packages/ui/project.json's stories-generate/stories-check targets removed.
DONE: apps/architecture-studio/scripts/generate-stories.mjs created (same logic, paths recalculated for its new location), generating apps/architecture-studio/stories/*.stories.tsx (7 files).

DONE: apps/architecture-studio/project.json gains stories-generate/stories-check targets (depending on ui:docs-mesh-export); storybook/build-storybook targets now depend on the local stories-generate instead of ui:stories-generate.

DONE: grep confirms zero remaining '@storybook'/'storybook' references anywhere under packages/ui/ except one pre-existing README line ('Storybook-independent JSON mesh') that predates this session and correctly documents the already-intended design.
DONE: storybook build succeeds from the new location; packages/ui's own tsc/tests(9)/api-check and architecture-studio's tsc/tests(8) all pass unchanged.
risks: Purely a file-relocation + path-recalculation change -- no logic changes to the generator or the generated story content.
